name: Chibana Ryouka
source: A renowned ace when it comes to long distance races, she transferred to Keisen Academy from a school noted for its track and field club. She appears to know and have some kind of interest in [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url].
translation: 长跑项目的著名王牌选手，从田径部闻名的学校转学到庆泉学园。她似乎认识[url=/c22455]关谷明人[/url]，并对他抱有某种兴趣。
